settings.heading: Build your plan
settings.subheading: Choose your tier, set your frequency, and skip or pause anytime. Fresh coffee on your schedule, not ours.

settings.caption: How it works
settings.heading: Coffee that turns up before you run out
settings.text: Every subscription is roasted to order in North Williamstown and dispatched within days. Change, skip or cancel from your account, no calls needed.

settings.title: Choose your tier
settings.text: Green, Silver or Gold Line — or the Bourbon Rosado Flight if you want to taste the range.

settings.title: Set your frequency
settings.text: Every week, fortnight or month. Most homes land on a bag a fortnight.

settings.title: Skip or pause anytime
settings.text: Going away? Skip a delivery or pause the plan from your account. It picks up where you left it.

settings.title: Save on every order
settings.text: The discount applies to every delivery while the plan is active, on top of any sale price.

settings.heading: Subscription savings
settings.text: Pick how you want to pay. The longer the commitment, the bigger the saving on every bag.
settings.note: Savings apply to the subscribed products on every delivery. Prepaid plans are billed once up front and can't be paused, but you can move delivery dates.
settings.included_text: Free delivery across Melbourne on orders over $50, first access to seasonal microlots, and a free bag on every fifth delivery.

settings.text: Bourbon Rosado finished four ways: washed, natural, honey and anaerobic. Subscribe to the Flight and taste how process changes a coffee, delivered on your schedule.

settings.question: Can I change my coffee between deliveries?
settings.answer: Yes. Swap the coffee, the grind or the size from your account before the next delivery is roasted.

settings.question: How do I skip or pause?
settings.answer: From your account, up to 48 hours before a delivery is due. Skipping moves that delivery to the next date; pausing holds the plan until you resume it.

settings.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
settings.answer: The Flexible plan has none — cancel anytime. Prepaid plans are billed once for the term you choose and end automatically unless you renew.

settings.question: When is my card charged?
settings.answer: Flexible plans are charged when each delivery is roasted. Prepaid plans are charged once, when you subscribe.

settings.question: Does the discount stack with sales?
settings.answer: Yes. The subscription saving applies to the current price of the coffee, including sale prices.

settings.heading: Fresh coffee on your schedule
settings.text: Choose a tier, pick a frequency and we'll take care of the rest.
